Strategy: Use the winning band only when residuals are spread wider than thirty, so the band chooses among genuinely varied bins. It may help by applying the band where choice matters, but may fail if wide states are rare.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if max(bins) - min(bins) > 30 and r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) for r in bins]
```
